explanation: Matches the second question: there is an open connected region R and a countably infinite family of unit segments, with open segments contained in R, that is maximal among pairwise-disjoint families of unit segments in R (maximality is over all families). The disjointness notion is the same as in part i and equivalent to disjointness of the open segments. The docstring cites [Fo99], which is not in the reference list, but this does not affect the statement.
